label: The selected PLG assumptions have no strict step with a weak return path
paraphrase: For the supplied set of PLG assumptions, no antecedent-to-consequent step of an initial strict full or partial sequent has a finite return path using antecedent-to-consequent steps of initial sequents of any kind. The return can have length zero, which excludes strict self-steps. Every antecedent of a full sequent is considered.
